fullDescription: A high-concept, minimalist interactive design system featuring monochromatic aesthetics and sophisticated particle physics. Characterized by a 'brutalist-lite' off-white background (#f5f3f0), technical typography (Space Grotesk), and a prompt-driven user experience. This style is ideal for creative agencies, experimental tech portfolios, and high-end SaaS landing pages where micro-interactions and generative visual storytelling are prioritized. Key features include a custom 'difference' blend-mode cursor, real-time particle text generation, and fluid, physics-based dispersion effects.

structured.summary: A minimalist, monochromatic interactive experience where a central typographic element transforms into dynamic, physics-driven particles upon user interaction. The system uses a prompt-based input to allow real-time content modification while maintaining a strict, clean aesthetic with high-contrast elements and spacious layouts.

style.description: Monochromatic and technical. The palette is anchored by a warm off-white background (#f5f3f0) and pure black (#000000) for all text and UI elements. Typography relies exclusively on 'Space Grotesk' in varying weights, emphasizing large, tight-tracked hero text and tiny, widely-tracked metadata. Animation is central, utilizing a particle system with three distinct primitive types (dots, rings, crosses) and physics-based behaviors like friction, easing, and radial dispersion.
style.prompt: Create a design system using an off-white background (#f5f3f0) and black text (#000000). Typography: Use 'Space Grotesk'. Hero text should be font-weight 500, font-size 14vw, with letter-spacing -0.05em. UI labels should be font-size 8px to 10px, uppercase, with tracking 0.2em to 0.3em. UI elements: Use 1px borders with 10-20% black opacity. Cursor: Implement a custom 12px black circle cursor with 'mix-blend-mode: difference' that disappears when hovering interactive text elements. Particle System Details: Generate particles from text silhouettes using a 2px grid. Particle types: 92% dots (filled), 4% rings (stroked, 0.5px width), 4% crosses (stroked, 0.5px width). Physics: 200px interaction radius, friction 0.95, ease 0.05-0.1, with a continuous slow drift (velocity +/- 0.5px per frame).

layout_and_structure.description: A fixed-frame layout that prioritizes a large central interaction zone, framed by technical metadata and navigation at the screen edges.

prompts.prompt: Fixed header at top: 48px (top: 12) from screen edge, 48px padding on sides. Left side: metadata tag in 10px uppercase text, tracking 0.3em. Right side: A vertical stack containing a text input field and a sub-label. Input field: 256px width (w-64), transparent background, border-bottom 1px black (10% opacity), text-align right, font-size 14px. Sub-label: 8px uppercase text, tracking 0.2em, 30% opacity black.

Centered hero area. Large display text (14vw) that remains invisible while particles are active during hover. An invisible trigger overlay (z-index 30) spans the text dimensions to capture mouse events. Particle canvas (z-index 10) covers the full viewport, rendering the text as a collection of primitives.

Fixed footer at bottom: 48px (bottom: 12). Center-aligned elements: a horizontal divider (96px width, 1px height, 20% opacity black) followed by a 10px uppercase text label with 0.2em tracking at 30% opacity.

special_ui_components.description: A minimalist text input that controls the central generative experience.
special_ui_components.prompt: Style a text input with no background and no border except a thin 1px bottom border at #0000001a (10% opacity). On focus, the border should darken to #00000066 (40% opacity). The text should be right-aligned, uppercase, tracking-wide, and responsive to real-time keystrokes to trigger particle re-generation.

special_ui_components.description: Typographic particles that react to cursor proximity.
special_ui_components.prompt: Implement a canvas-based particle system where particles form a text string. On hover: particles within 200px of the mouse should move away from the cursor along a vector calculated from the center, with a force of (200 - distance) / 200 * 15. On mouse leave: particles should snap back to their original 'text shape' coordinates using a random ease value between 0.05 and 0.1 for a fluid, natural motion.

structured.special_notes: MUST: Ensure font-family 'Space Grotesk' is fully loaded before calculating particle coordinates from the canvas pixel data. MUST: Toggle visibility of the static hero text to 0 opacity instantly upon hover to reveal the underlying particles. MUST NOT: Use colors other than #f5f3f0 and #000000; all depth must be achieved via opacity layers (10%, 20%, 30%, 40%, 70%). MUST: Keep the particle density responsive by adjusting the sampling gap based on string length and screen width.
